test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 06
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not an example of a Word Processor?
solution:
__
 
• Microsoft Excel is a spreadsheet developed by Microsoft for Windows, macOS, Android and iOS. It features calculation, graphing tools, pivot tables, and a macro programming language called Visual Basic for Applications.
 
• **Microsoft Word is a word processor developed by Microsoft.**__
 
• Word Star is a word processor application published by Micro Pro International.
 
• Word Perfect (WP) is a word processing application owned by Corel.
